paragraphs.source_zh: “大人。”阿袖道，“阿袖并非一个好女人。若大人把妾身带到京城，就等于带上了一个累赘……妾身亦是一个倔犟的女人啊。”

paragraphs.source_en: Without a word, Mitsunari took Osode’s hand, though his gaze still drifted elsewhere. Even so, the rims of his eyes had reddened.
